name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
state: The UK national terrorism threat level has been Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, since JTAC raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (MI5). No change had been announced as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Follow MI5 and police guidance on staying alert in crowded places; report concerns to the police.
why: The official MI5 assessment of the likelihood of a terrorist attack in the UK.
